Application to amend the Zoning By-law for 445 Anndale Road
Changes to the Zoning Bylaw for this location are required before a permit can be issued. This means that they submit an application that is reviewed by city planners and other agencies plus city council before anything can be built.
Anndale Holdings Inc. is proposing to build five blocks of townhouses with 13 linear townhouse units and 42 stacked townhouse units. The plan also includes 78 parking spaces and an additional 35 parking spaces to be shared between the existing spiritual use and visitor parking spaces. The existing church will be retained.
View the documents submitted by the development company under supporting documents on this page for more details and drawings.
Summary of Changes
A summary of changes between Submission 1 and Submission 2 prepared by the Applicant can be found in the
Cover Letter & Comment Response Matrix (PDF)
found under the Documents section of this webpage, and in the tables below.
Submission Details
The changes proposed to the Zoning By-law are outlined in the below chart:
Submission 1
rezoning the lands from Residential One (R1) to Residential Eight (R8)
increasing the maximum permitted building height to 12 m from 10 m
permit 35 parking spaces to be shared between church and visitor parking
permit 'spiritual use' as a permitted use in the R8 zone
Submission 2
rezoning the lands from Residential One (R1) to Residential Eight (R8)
increasing the maximum permitted building height for a pitched roof to 12 m from 10 m
permit 35 parking spaces to be shared between church and visitor parking
permit 'spiritual use' as a permitted use in the R8 zone
permit a maximum encroachment of 2.5 m for decks within the streetline setback of Davenport Road

Images are provided by the applicant and may not reflect the final design approved by the planning division.
